title: Quantization-Aware Neuromorphic Architecture for Skin Lesion Classification on Resource-Constrained Devices
abstract: arXiv:2507.15958v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-device skin lesion analysis is constrained by the compute and energy cost of conventional CNN inference and by the need for lightweight calibration under clinical data shift. Neuromorphic processors provide event-driven sparse computation, but practical deployment is often limited by CNN-to-SNN conversion failures, including unsupported operators, quantization distortion, and accuracy degradation under class imbalance. We propose QANA, a quantization-aware CNN backbone within an end-to-end pipeline for conversion-stable neuromorphic execution. QANA improves conversion robustness by bounding intermediate activations, aligning normalization with low-bit quantization, and replacing conversion-fragile components with spike-compatible transformations. translated_title: 面向资源受限设备的皮肤病变分类的量化感知神经形态架构
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2507.15958v5 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：设备端皮肤病变分析受到传统CNN推理的计算和能源成本限制，以及在临床数据偏移下需要轻量级校准的约束。神经形态处理器提供事件驱动的稀疏计算，但实际部署常常受限于CNN到SNN转换失败，包括不支持的算子、量化失真和类不平衡下的精度下降。我们提出QANA，一种量化感知的CNN骨干网络，集成在端到端流程中，以实现转换稳定的神经形态执行。QANA通过限制中间激活、将归一化与低比特量化对齐，以及用尖峰兼容变换替换转换脆弱组件，来提高转换鲁棒性。通过基于Ghost的特征生成、空间感知的高效通道注意力，以及可操作的挤压-激发模块，实现了高效表示。
tldr: 本文提出QANA，一种量化感知的CNN架构，通过改进转换鲁棒性和高效特征表示，解决了神经形态处理器上皮肤病变分类的部署难题，适用于资源受限设备。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QANA, a quantization-aware CNN architecture that addresses deployment challenges of skin lesion classification on neuromorphic processors by improving conversion robustness and efficient feature representation for resource-constrained devices.
